member.name: M:CustomerAPI.WebAPI.Extensions.ServiceBuilderExtensions.AddMyInboxOutbox(Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection.IServiceCollection,Microsoft.Extensions.Configuration.IConfiguration)
member.summary:
Registers the Inbox/Outbox pattern with EF Core-backed durable stores.
Design note: and are registered as Scoped so they share the same instance as the command handler's unit-of-work within a request scope. This allows outbox entries to be staged in the same change tracker and committed atomically.
The library's AddMvpInboxOutbox() registers stores as Singleton which conflicts with Scoped EF DbContext, so we wire up the components manually here.
